overview: FitKit Tracker — Bluetooth bike ride tracker with auto-save every 60 seconds and same-day ride resume.
features: Connect to FitKit bike via Bluetooth and display live speed, distance, calories, resistance, and cadence
Auto-save ride progress every 60 seconds during an active ride
Resume a partial ride from the same day if the app closes or Bluetooth disconnects
Clean dark sport-app UI with Start, Pause, and Stop controls
